noise_allowance.text: Norm in which contraction is measured: ||d_k||_tau = max_i |d_k,i|/tau_i. q = the larger of the last two observed ratios ||d_k||_tau/||d_k-1||_tau (with only one ratio, that ratio); there is no cap (A58 RI-18). For q < 1 the norm-level bound is E_i^norm = tau_i * ||d_last||_tau * q/(1-q), exactly; with exactly one increment, E_i = tau_i * ||d_last||_tau. Per-row bound for rows whose last two increments have the same sign (d_last,i * d_prev,i > 0): |d_last,i| * q_i/(1-q_i), q_i = |d_last,i|/|d_prev,i|, exactly (S7 without the 0.9 cap). Alternating bound for rows whose last two increments change sign: the tail of a geometric series with ratio -q_i, |d_last,i| * q_i/(1+q_i), q_i = |d_last,i|/|d_prev,i| (A56 N1). E_i = max(E_i^norm, same-sign bound, alternating bound). E is UNAVAILABLE for the run (its tests undecidable; to R-PAIR) when: no increment is observed; a tau-norm ratio >= 1 on either of the last two ratios (NEW-7); any row has q_i >= 1, same-sign or alternating (A56 N1); or a pass-row gap / row-ID defect exists (B4, S9). A slowly contracting run (q near 1) therefore gets a large E and goes to R-PAIR. E_i(pair) = E_i(a) + E_i(b). The geometric bound assumes the observed ratio is the map's contraction factor: DECLARED, checked against each run's own increments.

EPS.text: Numerical sup searches are estimates, not proofs; envelope consumers read the full-envelope fields (A57.4). q(k) sampled via QINF evaluator f58de0dc (cache 7b9816ae cross-check), 13+13 directions x 64/decade per unit shell of [K, K_big]; refined 26+26 x 128/decade; eps_s(refined) <= 1.1 eps_s(base) else refine; 2 refinement failures -> EPS_UNCERTIFIED. Coverage: DDO from 2 to at least sqrt2 * 2P (= 362.04 at P = 128; the DDO record covers [2, 363]); NGC at production K_big 32 with N3' to 64: >= sqrt2 * 64 = 90.5, i.e. [2, 91] (A64.2; supersedes RI-17's [2, 46], which was the K_big 32 N3-case edge of A58). The record carries envelope_bound {rule A52_5_SUP_OVER_DIRECTION_TIMES_CARDINAL_TORUS, coverage_max_inverse_kpc} with coverage >= sqrt2 * 2P (A52.5 as raised by A54). The top-level and nested "dominates" flags must agree; a disagreement is a RECORD_DEFECT (A67 N4). EPS does not depend on M_s (A68); the record of record is the EPS slot (A70: EPS_CERT_V006 598c8fa3 for DDO; EPS_CERT_NGC91 for NGC). Until such a record is slotted, per-shell values above 15 /kpc are lower bounds and SRB_ROT is not read. An estimate, not a proven sup.

Each shell <= 0.005 tau, summed <= 0.05 tau; coverage starts at lo >= K = 4 and reaches >= sqrt2 * 2P (A69.2, A54, A55.4). GQ.text:
For every gas roster used, the gas transform at M_s and at 2M_s agrees to <= 1e-12 * P0, certified per source geometry over the union of all T-case tail node domains (DDO C2T-C4T, C4T-KLO, C4T-KHI, incl. the corner zones). At production M_s 128 the DDO certificate is computed at M_s 128 against 256 over the full DDO reach on all nodes (A57.1); the all-nodes check uses the root-registered per-geometry production node counts from the gq_full part records, and a record whose all_nodes count equals the 4096 sample refuses (A67 SF1). Roster names map to geometries by the fixed map DDO_C2T -> C2T_KB

, DDO_C3T -> C3T_KB

The certificate M_s is bound as in LO (A68 CHK-1). It keeps RI-03's production-128 rule (A79 NEW-67). It states its DDO M_s as ddo_gas_M_s = 128, the field of the A73 merged format and of FIELDS_R12 DOUBLING, not as source_gas_M_s (rehearsal D-01, R-13).

I1T.text: at every tail build: roster transform vs packet source at 4096 seeded nodes <= 1e-12 relative (UV_TAIL_SOURCE_MISMATCH); the I1T record covers every T-case.

T2I.text: Before T2 is read: nodes_v001 transform replicas applied to the C5H rosters equal the C5H stored packet sources on G5\G4 to <= 1e-12 (route-A updated per iteration; offset new_body_fourier_J; feedback gas_source_feedback). A T2I failure reads IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT (T2I).

SRB_ROT.text: static rotation-law channel bound (V001 sec 1.4, renamed; necessary, not sufficient) <= tau_i/10 on C4T. Computed on C4T: when C4T is flagged, a pass carries the flag and a failure is undecidable. Not read until the EPS envelope record (A52.5) is slotted.

RB_FP.text: RB-FP_i = 2 * eps_max * |dv_i/dlambda| * kappa_i <= tau_i/10; dv_i/dlambda := (|v_i(C4T-A) - v_i(C4T)| + E_i(C4T-A, C4T))/0.05 (conservative); the noise contribution 2 kappa_i eps E_i/0.05 is recorded; kappa_i = sum_s|dV_static_is| / |sum_s dV_static_is| (shell split, saved C4T); first-order response DECLARED, UNTESTED. E is the Picard allowance only. If C4T's E is unavailable (NEW-7, A56 N1) or C4T has a B4 gap, RB_FP reads E from C4T's Picard R-PAIR member (the 12-pass rerun admitting C4T's route A); C4T-A gets the same Picard path; both are on the resolvable list; an unresolved one, or RB_FP with undefined kappa, reads INCOMPLETE. Shell labels are read by index and never emitted verbatim in blinded modes (S6). The shell split covers the domain exactly [K, sqrt2 * P]; excess, shortfall or a partial-domain record refuses and never PASSes (A62.1, A67 N3, A69.2).

MT_monitor.text: route-A per-iteration M_T (static rotation-channel effect of t[S_T(updated_n)] - t[S_T(gas_n)] at 12 row radii x 8 azimuths in tau units, v_ref = A2F10 route_a_rows); M_T(accepted) <= 1/4 else flag TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED (stopping rule unchanged). An MT verdict FAIL for a run is the TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED flag on that run; a defective MT record reads NO_RUN; an MT record, when supplied, covers every T-case.

In V007, LO_NGC is reported only (R1 L180): the V007 LO_NGC slot takes the LO_NGC record of record that exists at seal assembly (A81 RI-23). NGC I1-T of stars + H2 against the T120L fixed source must pass before any NGC N-test is read; the NGC N-tests get their own small compare, and no NGC N-test is read until LO_NGC, EPS_NGC and GQ_NGC to 91 are all slotted; coverage to 91 gates that NGC N-test compare (step 5), not the V007 seal (A81 RI-23, A64.2). Shells are keyed on range; a duplicate is a RECORD_DEFECT (A75 A01); an NGC roster with a different range refuses (A79.1). The V007 LO_NGC slot takes LO_NGC_CERT_V002 (33bc2190), the LO_NGC record of record (A87), reported only; LO_NGC_K32_CERT_V001 (07745bbf) is the NGC N-test record, with coverage to 91 (A90), and is not a V007 input.

HARMONIC.text: Reported, not deciding: a0/a4/a8 of dlnN/dR at route-A query 03 (R = 1.48 kpc), at the four diagonal azimuths, for C4T, C4T-D5 and C6T, and for C4R3, C5H and C6 direct (C6 from its checkpoint replay). A repeated HARMONICS row is a RECORD_DEFECT (A79.1).

RECEIPTS.text: A receipt is required for every run case; a missing receipt reads INCOMPLETE.

record_verdicts.text: A gate record whose verdict contradicts its own data is a RECORD_DEFECT (NO_RUN group), not a decided failure; a defective or malformed gate record reads NO_RUN with next step "fix the record or gate and re-review", never a physics reading. An unregistered record reads NO_RUN (A67 order N1). Seal-time record states: GQ_CERT_V003 (no all_nodes), LO_CERT_V003_MS128 (no source_gas_M_s), the c2v004 identity records and unregistered gate records read RECORD_DEFECT until re-emitted (A73).

no_last_wins.text: Any list-to-mapping conversion, and any JSON object, rejects duplicate keys before the mapping is built: shells, rows, cases, gates, members, tokens, registry entries, NPY/NPZ headers and the JSON parse itself (object_pairs_hook). A duplicate is a RECORD_DEFECT naming both entries by index or JSON path, never by a record label (blinding), even when the values are equal. Guards key on the semantic identity (case kind, roster name, shell range), not the whole object. NPZ archives: collisions are rejected both in raw member names and in the logical names NumPy uses; an extensionless NPY member is refused. No tool may be last-wins anywhere; the final compare round lists every dict-from-list site with its guard and a MUST_FAIL test. Every refusal site names both entries, including the fifteen sites listed in A79.6 (T01/T02; C02-C04 and S01; the registry duplicate-key forms; the S9/D2 row codes, C10, A06/A07/B09).

after_seal_marker_policy.text: PRODUCED_AFTER_THE_SEAL is accepted only for the nine gates whose records are produced after the seal: the eight computed from V007 run outputs (SRB_ROT, RB_FP, T2I, EA, MT, I1T, FLAG_RULINGS, HARMONICS) and SR_K, which the sealed pinned producers compute right after the seal on the fixed saved C2R3/C3R3/C4R3 states, before any T-run output is read (A88; r12 GATE_RECORD_AFTER_SEAL_ALLOWED L341 and GATE_RECORD_SHA_REQUIRED = () L338, A99.5). At compare time those records are verified by producer pin and producer bytes against the producer registry (A62.2, A69); SR_K keeps the bitwise-identical-Delta RECORD_DEFECT (A67 N2). The token is refused for EPS, GQ, LO, LO_NGC, DOUBLING, B0-B3 and the identity gates, whose records of record exist before the seal (A88), and for every other gate (r12).

c5h_interlock.text: c5h_path_hit and read_run catch /.vol/<dev>/<ino> aliases of the C5H run directory and its files, and hard links, by (st_dev, st_ino) against every file of the C5H run (H-07); rejecting any multiply-linked file on the protected device is the accepted conservative substitute for a per-file inode inventory (NEW-64); a failed os.stat of the registered C5H root is a refusal, never a silent drop (A79.3). The name test and the identity walk run on the resolved path as well as the lexical one; every prefix of realpath(s) is stat-walked against the registered (st_dev, st_ino); strings are NFC-normalized before every comparison, so firmlink (/System/Volumes/Data), NFD and symlink-then-/../ spellings are caught (A79.5). A refusal can delay the verdict but never changes a reading.

blinded_output.text: Blinded modes print codes only: the 13 early-refusal sites (A75.5) and the CLI parser, whose error() raises a typed refusal and prints a code only, with allow_abbrev=False and repeated flags refused (A79.2, A76 SF-ARGV).

certificate_ms_binding.text: Every certificate whose content depends on M_s states source_gas_M_s; it must equal the record's own gas_M_s, its tail_config gas.M_s and the case block's registered gas.M_s, and for DDO that value must be 128 (both bindings hold together). A superseded M_s 64 certificate refuses in an M_s 128 context; a matched-64 control refusing is correct.

T1.text: Pass iff cases C2T, C3T, C4T are valid AND V005 criterion.shape_pass literally (Dhat_T(3,4) <= 1 AND Dhat_T(3,4) <= 0.5 * Dhat_T(2,3)) AND RA6: for every row i, d23_i * d34_i >= 0 and |d34_i| <= 1/2 |d23_i|, where d23_i = v_i(C3T) - v_i(C2T), d34_i = v_i(C4T) - v_i(C3T); if d23_i = 0 the row passes only if d34_i = 0. TINY (DECLARED; applies to the RA6 clause only): a row is TINY iff |d23_i| <= tau_i/8 and |d34_i| <= tau_i/8; TINY rows are exempt from the per-row clause and stay in Dhat. No floor clause; FLOOR_LIKE pre-named (D14). Known blind spot (G5): a growing row whose increments both stay <= tau/8 is exempt; the backstop is T1_H.

T1_H.text: C6T against C4T: per row |v_i(C6T) - v_i(C4T)|/tau_i <= 1/2 every row, decidable; no TINY exemption. C6T is consistent through RO1.

T1_S.text: {"runs": ["S4T", "C4T"], "statistic": "max_i |dv_i|/tau_i", "pass": "<= 2 (V005 tau_shape_agreement)", "S4T": "route-B sphere mask with sphere tail; route A, reference, body cube with cube tail"} ("sphere tail" for S4T = sphere truncation of the kept region with the cylinder K_big 128 outer tail; A62 note, A58 RI-05.)

T2c.text: C4T-C5c (continuum_v001, E1, outer cube K_out = 5) against C4T-D5: per row |dv_i|/tau_i <= 1/2 (PASS/FAIL); a failure reads SOURCE_RULE_MATERIAL.

T3.text: With production K_big P = 128: T3 = {C4T-KLO (K_big 64 = P/2), C4T-KHI (K_big 256 = 2P)}, each against C4T at P per row <= tau/4, decidable. Producers emit the labels C4T-KLO and C4T-KHI; A55's "C4T-K64/K256" is descriptive only. The compare reads P, P/2 and 2P from the registered case block and refuses any other values; the R1 labels C4T-K16/C4T-K64 are retired.

SR_K.text: {"kind": "static replay", "states": ["C2R3", "C3R3", "C4R3"], "K": [2, 3, 4], "statistic": "Delta_i(K) = rows[packet_K(S_pkt)+t_K] - rows[packet_K(S_T)+t_K] (unit response from each case 01_offset/unit_response.npz); pairwise K-dependence", "use": "reported; enters u_i and the T1-fail reading as max(|Delta_i^SR(4)|, |Delta_i^SR(4)| * A_i), A_i = |dv_i/dlambda| / |dV_i^static,tail| from the AMP run (DECLARED, UNTESTED); the static value is labelled \"static only; fixed-point UNTESTED\", deciding test C4T-SR; flag SOURCE_QUADRATURE_MATERIAL if that max exceeds tau_i on any row"} SR_K and its gate record are bound to root-registered producer shas with producer-byte verification (A62.2, A69). A88 (amending A79 NEW-61 for SR_K only): the SR_K record is produced right after the seal, before any T-run output is read, by the sealed pinned producers (sr_k_static v009, aggregate_records v008) on the fixed saved C2R3/C3R3/C4R3 states, so it depends on no T result; its registry entry carries the producer pins and PRODUCED_AFTER_THE_SEAL; root runs it as the first post-seal step (RUNBOOK); a synthetic or fixture record refuses; a bitwise-identical Delta across K is an SR_K RECORD_DEFECT (A67 N2).

outcomes_first_applicable.text: Any identity or implementation gate fails (B0, B0prime_DRY, B0prime_RERUN, B0_FA, B0_RO1, B0_N3, B1/Z2, Z2_OFF_RO1, B2, B3; a B2/B3 failure is IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT of the gate), or a gate record is defective, malformed or contradicts its data (RECORD_DEFECT). Next: fix and re-review. Every reading names every missing or invalid case and gate. An unregistered record reads NO_RUN (A67 order N1); a duplicate anywhere is a RECORD_DEFECT (A71).

Placed directly after NO_RUN. Any registered V007 case (T-runs, C5H, identity-gate runs) invalid or missing, including BRACKET_HULL_MISS, a missing receipt, a pass-row gap or row-ID defect, RB_FP with undefined kappa -> name each case and gate with its next step; no T-test is read. Subtypes: CASES_OR_RECORDS (tests unread) and UNRESOLVED (tests read: ADOPT_TAIL or FLAG_PENDING_RULING with a pending step; a NOT_UV/SRKD split that turns on a flag).

Same position. NUMERICS_UNCERTIFIED: EPS uncertified, DOUBLING fails, GQ fails or a GQ/EPS coverage shortfall. NON_LAPSE_TAIL_MATERIAL: LO fails (LO_NGC for NGC readings). Next: named successor. No T-test is read.

outcomes_first_applicable.text: Read in this order: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT: T2 decidable and fails; stop, T1/T3 not read as physics (also a T2I failure: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT (T2I), A48 AMB-10) | SOURCE_RULE_MATERIAL: T2c fails; root ruling on the gas rule before adoption | KBIG_NOT_CONVERGED: T3 fails; T3prime: production 2P with {P, 4P} (= 256 with {128, 512} at P = 128); EPS/LO coverage >= sqrt2 * 4P (A56 N4; R1's "production K_big 64 under T3prime (32/64/128), EPS and LO to 128" is superseded) | BOUND_INSUFFICIENT: RB_FP or SRB_ROT fails; next: q-corrected shell (second asymptotic order), design successor | FLOOR_LIKE (D14): T1 fails only by a contraction clause (max-based or per-row, RA6) with Dhat_T(2,3) <= 1 and Dhat_T(3,4) <= 1; takes precedence over the two T1-fail readings below; a floor clause needs a new prereg version before any further case | NOT_UV_RESIDUAL: T1 fails AND T2c <= tau_i/4 every row AND SR-K pairwise K-dependence (2,3),(3,4) <= tau_i/4 AND no TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED flag; next: column/Picard map, own prereg | SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_K_DEPENDENT: T1 fails otherwise; next: fixed-point SR runs C2T-SR/C3T-SR/C4T-SR (packets over the smooth source), own design and prereg | HIGHER_K_DISAGREEMENT: T1 passes and T1_H fails; adopt nothing; C6T candidate under a V007 amendment sealed before further results | SHAPE_DISAGREEMENT: T1_S fails; review per-stage C wiring. A decided failure is read when its own condition is fully decided even if another step is unresolved; the pending steps are listed.

Only if no decided failure outcome applies and some test with a TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED run failed (flags are evaluated per test: a flagged test that passes, passes with the flag carried; one that fails is undecidable and cannot trigger IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT, NOT_UV_RESIDUAL, SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_K_DEPENDENT or FLOOR_LIKE). Next: rerun that case with seed source_rtol/10.

A paired test still undecidable after R-PAIR: neither pass nor fail; no adoption. Both undecidable readings are listed when both apply. A C4T-KHI B4 gap whose Picard members reach the floor reads UNDECIDABLE_AT_ITERATION_FLOOR, PROVISIONAL; it is undecidable and adopts nothing (A67 NEW-31).

Every gate and test passes but a flag stays unruled (SOURCE_QUADRATURE_MATERIAL, or TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED on an adoption run); no adoption; needs every step resolved; root rules on the flag (a flag ruling is a root addendum entry naming the flag, run and evidence, registered before any adoption reads the flagged test).
The decision rule holds and every step is resolved.

outcome_reading_rules.text: Any reading made while a step at an earlier position is pending is marked PROVISIONAL, with the pending steps listed. A decided T3, T1-split or SHAPE reading stands while T2/T2I is pending, marked PROVISIONAL.
"No T-test is read" applies to NO_RUN, INCOMPLETE and NUMERICS_UNCERTIFIED/NON_LAPSE_TAIL_MATERIAL; T values may be reported descriptively, labelled "not read".
Governing principle: no ruling may make adoption easier than the text; where the text is silent the stricter-on-adoption reading is chosen.
A V1-V6 failure other than BRACKET_HULL_MISS -> named defect, fix and rerun that case under V007 with thresholds unchanged.
